subject: Remote data access from shiny app and password-protecting shiny app

messages.author: 433c997c93cf1199
messages.subject: Remote data access from shiny app and password-protecting shiny app
parts:
Dear all,

again, thanks for driving Shiny further, I particularly love the new google vis stuff!

Two quick question regarding integrating a shiny app with other web applications:

(1) Are there any straightforward ways for a Shiny app to fetch data (e.g. larger database tables) from other web applications, ideally via a REST web service call?

(2) Are there any straightforward ways for protecting the access to my Shiny app web page with a login and password, which again could be delivered via a REST call from a different web application?

Thanks so much in advance! All the best,

Ignacio
